meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪短篇网文热门趋势，发现风口题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速掌握平台热门题材
copy.tagline_en: Track short story trends and discover viral topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web novels and want to catch trending themes

howto.what: 装上后，它会先确认你要扫哪个平台和什么方向，再抓取页面或读你给的数据，分析短篇榜单的情绪热点、题材、人设等，最后给出扫榜报告（含情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警、可写方向），还标注报告有效期和下次复扫时间。
howto.when: 当你说出或输入“/story-short-scan”、“/短篇扫榜”、“短篇什么火”等触发语时，进入短篇扫榜流程。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言最近的热门短篇。
say.note: 会先确认平台，然后开始采集榜单数据。

say.text: 七猫短篇现在什么题材火？
say.note: 会针对七猫分析情绪和题材热点。

say.text: 对比黑岩和点众的短篇榜单。

howto.what_en: After install, it asks platform/direction, gathers data via scraping or user input, analyzes emotions/themes/characters, outputs a report: emotion rankings, hot themes, risk alerts, suggested directions, validity date, and next rescan time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type or say "/story-short-scan", "/短篇扫榜", "短篇什么火", or similar intent phrases like "知乎故事排行".

say_en.text: Scan the latest hot short stories on Zhihu Yanyan.
say_en.note: It will confirm the platform and start data collection.

say_en.text: What genres are hot in Qimao short stories now?
say_en.note: It will analyze emotions and hot themes for Qimao.

say_en.text: Compare the short story rankings of Heiyan and Dianzhong.
say_en.note: It will do a cross-platform comparison.
